question: The Constitution (Scheduled Castes) Order Amendment Bill, 2021 was introduced in the Lok Sabha on 13 February 2021, which amended the Constitution (Scheduled Castes) Order, _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1950.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Constitution** (Scheduled Castes) Order (Amendment) Bill, 2021** was presented in Lok Sabha by the Minister of State for Social Justice and Empowerment,** Mr. Krishan Pal Gurjar, on February 13, 2021.**
 
• The Bill alters the Constitution (Scheduled Castes) **Order, 1950.**
 
• The Statement of Objects and Reasons of the Bill expresses that the Bill has been acquainted with give impact to alterations proposed by the territory of Tamil Nadu.
 
• **The 1950 Order **additionally incorporates the Kadaiyan people group inside the rundown of advised SCs in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Parliament has passed the Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order (Amendment) Bill, 2022 with **Rajya Sabha endorsing it.**
 
• There are three sorts of alterations to the Constitution of India of which second and third kind of changes are represented by **Article 368.**
 
• **Lok Sabha **had proactively passed the Bill.
 
• Charges looking to revise any remaining arrangements of the Constitution incorporating those counted in the stipulation to article 368(2) are called by the title 'Constitution Amendment Bills'.
 
• These Bills can be presented in one or the other **House of Parliament.**
